failures: ● PKG-006 durable application command identity (GAP-0031) › a lost ACK survives a route remount: the original command is restored, never resent automatically, retried with the same key and payload, and cleared on the receipt
● PKG-006 durable application command identity (GAP-0031) › the identity is journaled before the send; a storage failure prevents the send and keeps the composer editable
● PKG-006 durable application command identity (GAP-0031) › another account cannot see or erase the pending command; the same account restores it after a later incarnation
● PKG-006 durable application command identity (GAP-0031) › a corrupt journal value is discarded without stranding the composer
● PKG-006 durable application command identity (GAP-0031) › a known refusal of the retried command permits a reset that clears the journal; an unknown outcome keeps it
● PKG-006 durable application command identity (GAP-0031) › a malformed receipt from the retried command stays unconfirmed and keeps the journal
